name: Zimri
title: Condemned Conspirator
summary: Zimri was an officer in the Israelite army who conspired against and killed King Elah of Israel. He reigned for only seven days before taking his own life when he was besieged by Omri, the commander whom the people had chosen as king in his place.

keyEvents.title: Kills King Elah
keyEvents.description: Zimri, who was commander over half the chariots, conspired against King Elah and killed him while he was drunk in Tirzah.

keyEvents.title: Destroys Baasha's House
keyEvents.description: After seizing power, Zimri wiped out the entire family of Baasha, fulfilling the word of the prophet Jehu.

keyEvents.title: Seven-Day Reign
keyEvents.description: Simri reigned only seven days in Tirzah before the people revolted against him and chose the army commander Omri as king.

keyEvents.title: Death by Fire
keyEvents.description: When Simri saw that the city had been captured by Omri's forces, he entered the royal palace and set it on fire over himself.

keyEvents.title: The Cause of His Downfall
keyEvents.description: The Bible explains that Simri died because of the sins he committed by doing what was evil in the Lord's sight.
